newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK CHIRANA TO ISSUE SKK 500 MLN, 5-YR BOND.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK CHIRANA TO ISSUE SKK 500 MLN, 5-YR BOND.

text.p: Slovakia's largest medical equipment producer, Chirana Prema a.s., said on Wednesday it would issue a 500 million crown tranche of five-year bonds on March 3.
The bond, with a lower price limit set at par, carries a fixed coupon of 13.5 percent per annum, paid semi-annually. The bonds are callable after three years of the issue date.
The paper will have a nominal value of 10,000 crowns and will be traded on the Bratislava Stock Exchange.
Chirana's Economic Director Milislava Zelmanova told Reuters the manager of the issue would be local investment firm Slavia Capital.
Zelmanova said the funds from the issue would be used to cover the company's investment activities over the next five years. She would not elaborate further.
